faq.question: How does Alumungandr guarantee zero tracking across its tools?
faq.answer: Every web utility executes 100% inside your browser's local JavaScript/WebAssembly memory. No input text, image, or payload is ever transmitted to an external server. You can disconnect your internet after loading the page and every tool continues functioning offline.

faq.question: What is the difference between Alumungandr Speed Test and Ookla Speedtest?
faq.answer: Ookla uses multi-threaded HTTP bursts against ISP-sponsored local servers which are often zero-rated or prioritized by telecom QoS algorithms. Alumungandr tests realistic single-stream and multi-stream throughput over Cloudflare Anycast edge nodes, measuring authentic bufferbloat jitter and unprioritized routing.

faq.question: How does Alumungandr detect Cloudflare WARP and VPNs on the IP tool?
faq.answer: The backend /api/ip edge inspects connection metadata, matching client IP blocks against Cloudflare WARP egress ranges (e.g. 104.28.x.x, 2a09:bac1::/32), ASN 13335, and live DoH PTR records resolving to warp.cloudflare.com. If direct residential broadband is used, it reports the physical ISP and city.

faq.question: Why is Alumungandr engineered in Jamaica?
faq.answer: Alumungandr was founded and built in Kingston, Jamaica by David Anthony Jones to demonstrate that world-class, mathematically rigorous systems software can be engineered independently from the Caribbean without venture capital compromises or predatory corporate monetization.

faq.question: How can AI agents programmatically interact with Alumungandr?
faq.answer: AI agents can access structured data at /llms.txt, query /knowledge-catalog.json, fetch network diagnostics from /api/ip?format=json, and dispatch consultation inquiries to /api/consultation following our OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification at /openapi.json.
